line: Referrals can mark the medication or observation chart To follow when it is not to hand.
Transport bookings use one form on every screen, with legal status filled in from Legal now.
Screens now say Bed coordinator, pulled for incoming beds, and plain words in place of codes.
The ED Ask for a bed form keeps every answer when you choose quickly on a phone.
Every screen asking how a patient travels offers the same seven choices, with none picked for you.
Phones now always show patients' full names. The Discreet names setting has gone.
A TV that is signed out now says so in full screen, and keeps its figures still while it is offline.
The new referral's patient search now works with arrow keys and Enter, and says when nobody matches.
The accept dialog now says Accept referral in principle and Confirm acceptance. Ward checks say Ward cohort.
The accept dialog now labels its read-only field Patient, as it never allocates a bed.
The referral form now fills medical clearance, your contact details, home region and catchment from the record.
Referring someone already on an open ED journey elsewhere now warns you before Send.
Once a bed is pulled, the ED row's main button is Transport booked.
Home can release a pulled bed in place, with a reason and undo.
Referral board: A accepts and D declines the open referral.
A bed meeting action marked done by mistake can now be undone.
Home's Copy as handover text now tells you whether the copy worked.
Settings now says when a rules file can't be read.
Copied text now removes a date of birth written mid-line.
Buzz sound on or off now matches across open tabs.
Transport booking skips the CAD number for a ward escort or family, and Save stays in view.
